thread:
jess: FYI: we have a 02:00 UTC change window for the session-handshake rollout touching API, runtime, console, and router. Need pins and any hard blockers now.
raj: Runtime pinned to v4.1.0. We'll enable 'q8-fast' in canary only. No hotpatches during window.
lucca: Console ack. We're keeping legacy X-SESSION cookie support for 2 hours post-rollout and will turn on detailed cookie mismatch logs for 30m.
tom: Router: enabling cookie-swap (emit COOKIE_A + COOKIE_B). Plan: 1% -> 8% (15m) -> 25% (30m) -> hold 30m. Canaries gated on console matches and mobile auth.
jess: Rollback triggers: session loss >0.7%, auth 401s >0.4%, p99 latency +120ms. Anyone object?
raj: I'll add a smoke step in deployment: /health + 3 generation prompts across seq lengths. Abort on token decode errors.
lucca: Console metric: session.cookie.mismatch. Alert if >6/min. We'll post CSV of synthetic session match rates every 10m in this thread.
deploybot: deploy scheduled by @jess for change-window. target: runtime:v4.1.0, api:v3.3.0. canary: router.cookie-swap -> 1% at t+2m.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: raj (02:00-10:00 UTC). Pager rules active.
tom: Note: mobile webview has known cookie quirks. Mobile team on standby. If 401s spike, immediate router flag off.
jess: Runbook excerpt (quick paste):
```
# rollback router flag
/deploy toggle router.cookie-swap off --env prod --by @tom
# rollback runtime
/deploy rollback --service runtime --to v4.0.9 --reason "cookie-swap regressions"
```
raj: Dashboards: runtime.q8.errors, router.cookie.mismatch, api.deprecation.warns, console.session.drop. Thresholds: q8.errors >2/min, cookie.mismatch >6/min, session.drop >1/min.
lucca: Starting synthetic session emitter now to seed the canary. We'll post matching rates.
deploybot: Canary started: router.cookie-swap 1% at 5067891300. Monitoring groups pinged.
jess: Canary 10m smoke: console synthetic matches 99.4%, q8.errors 0. Mobile auth clean. Proceeding to 8% in 5m.
tom: Ramp scheduled. Will pause if mobile 401s increase.
oncall-bot: oncall acknowledgement recorded for raj.
raj: At 8% ramp observed p99 +95ms for long sequences. Not yet at rollback threshold but flagging for extended hold.
lucca: Console shows elevated cookie mismatch on a small host subset (3 hosts). Opening host-specific follow-up.
tom: Implemented host-level throttling for the 3 hosts. Mismatch dropped to 0.5/min.
deploybot: Canary paused at 8% for investigation. Awaiting green signals.
jess: Hold extended by 20m. Resume only when mismatch <1/min and p99 delta <100ms for 15m. If any fail, execute rollback steps.
lucca: Console fallback updated: if COOKIE_B missing, fall back to COOKIE_A header for affinity. Verbose logs on for 60m.
raj: Documented that q8-fast can increase latency on long sequences; added to release notes. Also added runtime rollback command to runbook.
tom: Proposal on resume: go to 20% (skip 25%) with 30m hold to capture more signals.
jess: Agreed. Resume checklist: console logs ok, runtime p99 stable, mobile auth ok, alerts clear.
deploybot: Canary resumed to 20% at 5067891420. Monitoring in flight.
jess: All clear so far. Update release notes with host-level throttle and console fallback details. Closing thread; will reopen on incidents. :thumbsup:
